title: Little Unicorns
tagline: Safe, Playful Connection for Young LGBTQ+ Kids & Allies
audience: Young LGBTQ+, questioning, and ally participants ages 9–13
schedule: Last Saturday of the month, 1:00 PM – 3:00 PM
location: DCVC Community Resource Center & Local Parks (Hobart Park)
summary: A gentle, affirming space where children and pre-teens can build self-esteem, socialize, and know they are celebrated just as they are.
description: Little Unicorns is designed for young LGBTQ+, questioning, and ally youth ages 9–13. We meet once a month on the last Saturday from 1:00 to 3:00 PM, talking about relevant issues, engaging in fun activities, and supporting each other in a safe, healthy, and relaxed atmosphere.
amenities: Age-tailored creative activities, games, and storytelling
Supportive group discussion on identity and belonging
Family and guardian networking in adjacent lounge
Safe and fully vetted adult facilitation
